title: Grilled Portobello Mushroom Stroganoff
cScaleSummary: C0 because the recipe contains no cholesterol-contributing animal-derived ingredients. The portobello and cremini mushrooms, egg-free whole-wheat noodles, olive oil, plant-based yogurt, vegetable stock, mustards, aromatics, herbs, and seasonings contribute 0 mg cholesterol.
ldlActiveSummary: LDL-Active because the dish is centered on mushrooms and whole-wheat noodles, uses unsaturated olive oil, and builds creaminess with unsweetened plant-based yogurt rather than butter, cream, or full-fat dairy. Its plant-forward, whole-grain structure supports LDL lowering.
intro: Stroganoff is traditionally a quick sauté finished with mustard and sour cream. This version keeps that sharp, creamy identity but makes whole grilled portobello caps the centerpiece. Charred mushrooms sit over broad whole-wheat noodles while browned cremini mushrooms give the tarragon-Dijon sauce depth and body.

items.prep: stems removed and dark gills scraped out

stepGroups.title: Prepare the Portobellos
items: Heat a gas or charcoal grill to high, about 450 to 500°F, and clean the grates.
Wipe the portobello caps ({{quantity:portobello-caps}}) clean. Remove the stems and gently scrape out the dark gills with a spoon so they do not muddy the pale sauce.

Brush both sides with the olive oil ({{quantity:olive-oil-portobellos}}), then season with the kosher salt ({{quantity:kosher-salt-portobellos}}) and black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper-portobellos}}).

stepGroups.title: Grill the Portobellos
items: Place the caps gill-side down over direct high heat. Grill without moving until deeply marked, 4 to 5 minutes.
Flip and grill cap-side down until tender but still substantial, 4 to 6 minutes more. Move them to indirect heat if they color too quickly.
Transfer to a board and rest for 5 minutes. Keep the caps whole until serving so they retain their juices.

stepGroups.title: Cook the Noodles
items: Bring the water ({{quantity:water}}) to a boil and add the kosher salt ({{quantity:kosher-salt-noodles}}).
Cook the egg-free whole-wheat wide noodles ({{quantity:whole-wheat-noodles}}) until just al dente. Reserve 1 cup of noodle water, then drain.

stepGroups.title: Brown the Cremini Mushrooms
items: While the noodles cook, heat a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add the olive oil ({{quantity:olive-oil-sauce}}) and cremini mushrooms ({{quantity:cremini-mushrooms}}), spreading them into a single layer.
Cook without frequent stirring until the mushrooms release their moisture and develop deep brown edges, 7 to 9 minutes.
Season with the kosher salt ({{quantity:kosher-salt-sauce}}) and black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper-sauce}}).

stepGroups.title: Build the Sauce
items: Reduce the heat to medium. Add the shallot ({{quantity:shallot}}) and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic ({{quantity:garlic}}) and cook for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the all-purpose flour ({{quantity:all-purpose-flour}}) and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.

Gradually whisk in the mushroom stock ({{quantity:mushroom-stock}}), scraping up the browned fond. Stir in the Dijon mustard ({{quantity:dijon-mustard}}), whole-grain mustard ({{quantity:whole-grain-mustard}}), soy sauce ({{quantity:soy-sauce}}), and vegan Worcestershire sauce ({{quantity:vegan-worcestershire}}).
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook until the sauce coats a spoon, 5 to 7 minutes.

stepGroups.title: Finish the Sauce Gently
items: Remove the skillet from the heat. Whisk a few spoonfuls of hot sauce into the room-temperature plant-based yogurt ({{quantity:plant-based-yogurt}}), then stir the tempered yogurt into the skillet.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of the fresh tarragon ({{quantity:fresh-tarragon}}) and the lemon juice ({{quantity:lemon-juice}}). Do not boil after adding the yogurt.
Taste and adjust salt, pepper, mustard, or lemon. If the sauce is too thick, loosen it with reserved noodle water a tablespoon at a time.

stepGroups.title: Plate and Serve
items: Divide the noodles among four shallow bowls and spoon the creamy tarragon-mustard mushroom sauce over them.
Slice each whole grilled portobello into thick 3/4-inch strips, keeping each cap together, and set one over each serving.
Finish with the remaining fresh tarragon and black pepper. Serve immediately.
